mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.member_id, c.content, c.created_at, m.name AS writer_name FROM comment c JOIN member m ON c.member_id = m.member_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.comment_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, member_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
